title: One United Properties buys EUR 10 mln Bucharest site for mixed-use tower
summary: Romanian real estate developer One United Properties announced that it acquired a 5,755 sqm plot on the Barbu Văcărescu Street in Bucharest for EUR 10 million. The company plans to build a residential-led mixed-use tower with an estimated gross development value of EUR 130 million. According to the preliminary concept, the building will have four underground levels, a ground floor, and 25 upper floors. Its above-ground gross built area is expected to reach approximately 25,900 sqm. The lower levels will include retail and office space, while the project will also provide around 2,000 sqm of green space. At more than 100 metres, it would become one of Romania’s tallest residential buildings.
